Testlify is the only platform with a live skill-percentile score for the same roles, pulled from real assessment results across our 3,500+ tests and 4,500+ job roles (the same Global Benchmarking engine that scores every candidate report). That lets us show what a role pays at a given skill percentile, not just at a given job title.
Notes: Headline: How much should a top-20% candidate cost? The skill-verified pay benchmark, role by role · What it'd be: A role-by-role report pairing public salary ranges with Testlify's own assessment-score percentile distribution for that role, so a reader can look up 'QA Engineer' and see both the going salary range and what skill percentile candidates at each pay band actually scored. Ships as an article with data tables now; an interactive percentile lookup is a future build.
